title: Peter Heals Aeneas in Lydda
description: Peter travels around and comes to the saints in Lydda, where he meets Aeneas, a man who has been bedridden for eight years. Peter tells him that Jesus Christ heals him and commands him to get up and make his bed. Immediately Aeneas gets up. All those living in Lydda and on the plain of Sharon see him, and they turn to the Lord.
